text: わしが　もらって　しまうぞ　ほんとうは　ほしいんじゃろ？

structure.jp: わしが　もらって　しまうぞ
structure.en: I'll just take it for myself

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing gets done completely, with no going back. もらって　しまう = 'I'll go and take it for good'.

patterns.name: 〜のだろう
patterns.explanation: んじゃろ is the old-man way to say のだろう, which asks the listener to agree with your guess. ほしいんじゃろ = 'you want it, don't you'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end makes the statement sound rough and forceful, here like a playful threat. しまうぞ = 'I will, you know'.
